# Lévis — acquisition manifest

Crawled **16 August 2026** for Part 8a. Everything below is the raw evidence the Lévis records were
encoded from; nothing in `data/places/levis/` was typed from memory or from the research memo.

## 1. What was crawled, and how

The catalogue is a TYPO3 extension behind CloudFront. Two things had to be got right:

* **CloudFront rejects the default `curl` user-agent with HTTP 403** ("Request blocked", generated by
  cloudfront). A browser user-agent plus `--http1.1` is required; with HTTP/2 the connection is reset
  by the peer. Every fetch below used
  `curl -sSL --http1.1 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) … Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"`,
  with up to four attempts and a sleep between requests.
* **The `idfiche` numbers do not follow the index order.** Boomtown is `idfiche=10`, Vernaculaire
  américain is `idfiche=1`. The ids were harvested from the index's hrefs, never iterated.

```bash
curl -sSL --http1.1 -A "$UA" -o html/index.html "$BASE/styles-architecturaux/"
grep -o 'idfiche=[0-9]*' html/index.html | grep -o '[0-9]*' | sort -un > idfiches.txt
while read n; do curl -sSL --http1.1 -A "$UA" -o "html/fiche-$n.html" "$BASE/styles-architecturaux/?idfiche=$n"; sleep 2; done < idfiches.txt
```

**The research memo said 21 courants. The crawl found 20.** The index was counted on the crawl, as
the brief's corrections table required, and 20 is what is published.

## 3. Terms of use — read before any image was handled

Source: Ville de Lévis, *Politiques de confidentialité et protection des renseignements personnels*,
sections « Conditions d'utilisation » and « Droits d'auteur »
(`html/politiques-confidentialite.html`). The operative passage, verbatim:

> Vous devez tenir pour acquis que tout élément que vous visualisez ou lisez dans le présent site Web
> est, sauf mention contraire, protégé par droits d'auteur et ne peut être utilisé sans l'autorisation
> écrite de la Ville de Lévis, sauf par vous à des fins non commerciales, pourvu que vous n'en
> modifiiez pas le contenu et que vous ne retiriez de celui-ci aucun avis relatif aux droits d'auteur
> ou autres droits de propriété intellectuelle. **Il vous est interdit de copier ou de publier, pour
> rediffusion à des tiers ou à des fins commerciales, la moindre partie du contenu.**

The site footer adds: « © 2026, Ville de Lévis. Tous droits réservés. »

**Finding: republication to third parties is expressly prohibited.** Personal, non-commercial,
unmodified viewing is permitted; publishing any part of the content onward is not.

**Decision.** No fiche image is copied into `assets/`. `assets/places/levis/` is deliberately empty.
Each type record carries a single `photos[]` entry with `file: null`, `kind: placeholder`,
`licence: "permission required"`, the fiche's `source_url`, and a credit that names the fiche and
quotes the prohibition; the type page renders it as a "Photograph pending" box carrying that credit.
The enumerated per-image list — historic strips, present-day strips, and the ANCIENNE / AVANT /
POTENTIEL / APRÈS restoration sets — is held with its URLs in `parsed.json`, and the mise-en-valeur
subset is repeated on each type record under the non-rendering key `fiche_photos`.

Four fiche images (three from fiche 15, one from fiche 17) were fetched **to a scratch directory
outside the repository** and viewed once, in order to settle the brief's conditional test for the
Beaux-arts courant ("encode if the fiche shows houses"). That is personal, non-commercial,
unmodified use and is within the terms; none of them entered the repository or the build. The test
resolved *yes* — the Beaux-arts line drawing is a two-storey dwelling with a covered veranda, quoins
and a modillion cornice, and its worked example is 55 avenue Bégin — so Beaux-arts is encoded as
residential.

No freely-licensed Wikimedia Commons substitute was pursued for Lévis in this pass; it remains the
route to actual imagery, alongside the permission request the brief flags for Part 8b.

## 5. What could not be fetched

| target | outcome |
|---|---|
| RPCQ inventory 1313, *Inventaire du patrimoine moderne de Lévis* (`detail.do?…&id=1313&type=invent`) | **HTTP 500** on every attempt. The inventory is cited in `place.yaml` and `sources.yaml` from the research memo, and is not independently verified here. |
| RPCQ advanced-search endpoint (`rechercheAvancee.do`) | **HTTP 404** — the query form has moved. The three RPCQ records used were reached by direct id instead. |
| Statutory pre-1940 inventory for Lévis | **Not located.** No document establishing whether Lévis has adopted one was found. The record asserts nothing either way; see the place notes. |
| Règlement RV-2019-19-74, full text and adoption date | **Not located** as a PDF. Only the City's explanatory page and the 4 March 2020 sector map were found; the by-law year is carried as 2019 with the adoption date flagged unverified. |
| Fiche images | **Deliberately not downloaded** into the repository — see §3. |

## 6. Findings that correct or resolve the brief

| item | brief said | verified source says |
|---|---|---|
| Courant count | memo "21"; brief "20, count it" | **20**, confirmed by harvest of the index hrefs. |
| Saint-Nicolas citation date | conflict: 5 November vs 5 October 1987 | **Resolved.** RPCQ 93507 statut block: *Citation, Site patrimonial, Municipalité (Lévis), 1987-10-05* — 5 October. Anterior statuses: *Avis de motion de citation, 1987-07-06* and *Citation, 1987-07-06*. The 5 November figure is unsupported by the register. |
| Maison Alphonse-Desjardins address | "6 rue du Mont-Marie" | RPCQ 92424: **8, rue du Mont-Marie**. Classed immeuble patrimonial **1983-03-21**; built 1882–1884. |
| Saint-Jean-Chrysostome cited site | "constituted 2001" | RPCQ 93382: citation **2001-08-20**, avis de motion 2001-05-07. |
| PIIA sectors | "the secteurs d'intérêt patrimonial" | **Thirteen** mapped sectors (Lévis, Lauzon, Saint-Romuald, Saint-Jean-Chrysostome, Saint-Nicolas, Charny, Saint-Rédempteur, Saint-Étienne, Saint-David, Pintendre, Breakeyville, New Liverpool, Vire-Crêpes), each graded Primaire / Secondaire / Périphérique / Spécifique, on a 14-sheet map dated 4 March 2020. |
| *Bâtiment mixte ou à vocation commerciale* | "yes, mixed-use" | Encoded **`is_residential: false`** instead. All seven of its fields describe shopfronts and signage, it carries no « Nombre à Lévis » count, and the catalogue files it under « Autre type ». Flagged in its `profile_note` and in the place notes. |

## 7. Reproducing the parse and the encode

```bash
python3 sources/levis/parse.py      # html/ -> parsed.json; aborts if fiche 10 or 1 stops matching
python3 sources/levis/encode.py     # parsed.json -> data/places/levis/types/*.yaml
python3 build.py                    # must print OK
```

`parse.py` re-asserts the brief's two transcribed reference fiches — idfiche 10 (Boomtown) and
idfiche 1 (Vernaculaire américain) — field by field on every run, including their previous/next
navigation, and exits non-zero on any mismatch. Both passed on the crawl of 16 August 2026.
`encode.py` writes every `profile_fr` string straight from `parsed.json`, so an empty profile table
is not reachable by hand-editing: it can only mean the parser failed.
